verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a Konnect AI Gateway v1 API reference with documented operations such as list-ai-gateways, so the product can be driven programmatically. It also exposes a documented provider-agnostic API for serving models. The OpenAPI probe only checked guessed root paths, so its 404s do not contradict the published API reference. Missing for 10: evidence of breadth beyond a single listed operation (create/update/delete of entities), documented auth and versioning details for the management API, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: list-ai-gateways summary: List AI Gateways description: Returns a list of AI Gateways in the organization.
The core of AI Gateway is the ability to serve AI Models from various AI Model Providers via a provider-agnostic API.
